name: Instanced Voxel Renderer
aliases: Instanced Voxel Renderer — Chunk-based Instanced Voxel Rendering
definition: A GPU-driven voxel rendering technique that packs shape instances into large Shader Storage Buffer Objects (SSBOs), groups them into spatial chunks, and renders them via instanced drawing with per-chunk frustum culling.
summary: The Instanced Voxel Renderer is a GPU-driven technique that packs voxel instances into SSBOs, groups them into spatial chunks, and renders them via instanced drawing with per-chunk frustum culling.
